timingFieldCorrection.definition: The timer starts in page.evaluate immediately before Playwright injects the external script, before the cold HTTP request, and stops after the bundle has evaluated.
timingFieldCorrection.separateRequestMetric: timing.cdpColdRequestMs spans CDP Network.requestWillBeSent through Network.loadingFinished; it overlaps the corrected request-to-initialization interval.

heapBoundary: Runtime.getHeapUsage.usedSize after HeapProfiler.collectGarbage, minus the same fresh page measured after GC before catalog injection.
transferBoundary: Sum of CDP Network.dataReceived.encodedDataLength events for the catalog script request. The server encodes the body using negotiated Brotli/gzip; decoded response bytes match the raw bundle size.
fixtureBoundary: Loopback static page and the registry/binding bundle only; not a deployed Next.js route or full Homarr app.
